description: Resolves (opening it if needed) the client conversation behind a campaign roster row and answers its conversationId, as opening the row's thread does, so you can read or reply in it with the inbox tools. Writes no message. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: open_campaign_conversation
title: Open a campaign person's conversation
